name: Myconid Adult (Additional Spore Effects)
subjectPrompt: A single Medium adult myconid corrupted by Zuggtmoy in Neverlight Grove. Compact fungal humanoid with a wide rust-red cap tipped unevenly to the side, visible pale gills and a tiny shadowed face recessed into the stalk with two small dark eye pits. Tough mossy gray-green stalk body and sturdy tapering limbs with rootlike toes. Warty lilac patches and a few orange shelf fungi have sprouted along the forearms and shoulders. Its stance is slowly advancing three-quarter front, one arm bent. Paint two small puffs of very fine spores close to its gills and the lifted arm, one muted yellow green and one dusky violet, both transparent enough to leave the silhouette clearly visible. Keep the size and one broad cap distinct from a sovereign. Do not give it clothing, weapons, humanoid muscle definition, a nose or human eyes.

name: Myconid Sovereign (Additional Spore Effects)
subjectPrompt: A single Large myconid sovereign corrupted by Zuggtmoy, towering, almost stately. Six distinct layered fungal caps as an asymmetrical crest, a dominant slate-purple cap widest at top, smaller lilac and bruised wine-red shelf caps along the shoulder line and upper stalk. Barklike blue-gray fibrous trunk, long branching arms, broad rootlike feet, dark vertical facial slits under the main cap. Its posture is upright, arms open and low as if conducting a slow pulse of spores. There are three small airy drifting eddies close to its form, soft sage, ochre and violet, suggesting the three additional spore effects. Fine organic specks only, with no explosive glow. Dark warped fungal ribs and ruffled gills recall demonic corruption. Borrow long anatomy and gills from the related Basidia illustration, making this a clearly original multi-capped figure with a distinct design. No staff, cloth, carved face or other creatures.
